findings.issue: detected-error preservation was recorded as having no portable call
findings.resolution: isolated named-error plans (CFI_ERROR_BASE_ADDR_NOT_NULL, CFI_ERROR_BASE_ADDR_NULL, CFI_ERROR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, CFI_INVALID_ATTRIBUTE) each asserting the macro and an unchanged descriptor snapshot

findings.issue: CFI_section expected elements were in row-major order
CFI_address plan used zero lower bounds and could pass if bounds were ignored
findings.resolution: rank-2 descriptor with nonzero lower bounds and exact pointer arithmetic

findings.issue: CFI_select_part did not assert the updated elem_len
findings.resolution: exact elem_len for component, substring and complex-part selections

findings.issue: reopened: CFI_establish with rank CFI_MAX_RANK+1 is not portable
findings.resolution: invalid-rank case recorded as no-oracle: CFI_rank_t is only 'a standard integer type capable of representing the largest supported rank' (18.5.4 p4), and dv must be large enough for the rank (18.5.5.5 p2)
